title: Phase-field digital image correlation for integrated displacement and damage measurements
summary: This work presents a novel digital image correlation (DIC) framework for full-field measurements of displacement, strain, and damage, based on a phase field (PF) approach. The idea is to take advantage of the ability of the PF method to track complex crack morphologies and to provide a natural way in DIC to perform damage and crack measurements from experimental speckle images, in addition to displacement and strain fields.
